top_signals.title: IDR/USD: Why Indonesia’s Rupiah Is So Weak And What It Means For the Economy
top_signals.summary: Indonesia’s rupiah — Asia’s worst-performing currency this year — has been under pressure since late 2024, as investors have grown increasingly concerned about the country’s fiscal outlook. Before the current period of volatility, the currency hadn’t traded at such low levels since the Asian Financial Crisis of 1997-98.
